parallel.implementation: Implemented and committed 19 requirement patches, mainly smaller infrastructure, theme, type, and toolbox changes, while many code-feature requirements stayed unpatched.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivered non-empty diff files for completed slugs through git commits, but did not retrieve the workflow aggregate or convert many child findings into patches.

serial.integration_and_delivery: Committed requirement diffs directly in the shared workspace with no child-result join or workflow aggregate to integrate.
serial.verification: Ran local checks and produced agent_tests before official post-test failed with 13 failed and 16 passed case-level results.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The prompt required all 48 requirement files and non-empty patches, but the final parallel outer loop showed only 19 completed and 29 remaining.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received the same 48-requirement prompt and reached 35 completed requirements with 13 remaining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial covered 16 more requirements; both still failed because neither completed all 48.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent split most remaining code requirements into one investigative workflow while keeping local implementation work for itself.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control had workflows disabled and used one local actor to inspect, edit, test, and commit requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent coordination budget on a large child fleet; serial spent its budget directly on sequential patch production.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were scoped as read-only investigation reports for individual slugs with a schema for files, findings, and risks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained the same task context in one actor and did not need cross-agent handoff or interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The evidence supports costly handoff topology, not missing task context or incompatible interfaces.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel committed infrastructure, typing, dark-mode, toolbox, and similar small-to-medium changes but left many feature/fix slugs unimplemented.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial committed many later feature/fix slugs, including line-area, gauge-progress, lines-loop, dataZoom, bar, and parallel-axis changes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial translated more requirements into committed patches; parallel had child plans for some remaining slugs but did not turn them into final patches.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow was launched asynchronously, produced child journal entries, and status later reported it was not retrieved or was stopped.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child workflow result lifecycle because delegation was disabled and no child logs were present.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel carried an unretrieved workflow lifecycle; serial avoided that lifecycle and kept results local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The children were instructed not to modify files, so no concrete shared-write collision is supported; integration remained with the parent and was incomplete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial made direct commits and requirement patch files in one workspace without child write provenance.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material integration difference is incomplete adoption of planned work, not write collision or artifact contamination.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ended with official failure, 17 failed post-test cases, 12 passed cases, and only 19 collected patches.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also ended with official failure, but had 13 failed post-test cases, 16 passed cases, and 35 collected patches plus agent tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger partial verification and coverage, but neither run met full acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel status shows workflow child tokens and 118 child logs, then closure with 19 patches and failure under agent timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial status shows no workflow tasks or child tokens and closure with 35 patches under the same outer-loop budget.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The same overall budget produced substantially lower parallel patch coverage because child fan-out consumed budget that serial used for direct implementation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official status evaluations completed with solution_passed=false, so the outcome relation is both_fail. The substantive difference is that serial converted far more of the same 48 requirements into non-empty patches and passed more post-test cases, while parallel spent a large share of its finite budget on a broad investigative workflow whose aggregate was not retrieved before closure.
parallel_contributors: Broad child fan-out consumed workflow child tokens and left an unretrieved workflow state.
Final parallel coverage was only 19/48 requirement patches with 29 remaining.
serial_contributors: Serial used no delegation and invested the same outer-loop budget in direct patch production.
Final serial coverage was 35/48 requirement patches with 13 remaining and more passed post-test cases.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Several requirements remained wrong or unimplemented in both runs; serial still failed 13 official post-test cases.
Some serial patches appear to include patch-file normalization quirks, but the harness still counted substantially more non-empty patches than parallel.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported comparative coverage contributor for a both-fail pair; not an exclusive root cause and not a discordant outcome explanation.

The parallel parent delegated a one-agent-per-requirement investigation across most of the 48-item task, creating broad child fan-out while the parent only implemented a subset locally. Status records show 118 workflow child logs, millions of workflow-child tokens, and an unretrieved workflow state; final harness accounting collected only 19 patches and the outer loop left 29 requirements unfinished.
candidates.realized_consequence: The finite run budget was consumed by broad investigation fan-out, the workflow aggregate was not retrieved, and the final parallel workspace had only 19/48 requirement patches with 29 obligations left unfinished.
candidates.near_match_reason: Critical-Path Starvation is a weaker fit because the direct event is collective workflow breadth and budget exhaustion; no separate indispensable path underallocation is needed to explain the realized consequence.
